one_liner: Cloud communications APIs (SMS, voice, video, verify) for developers, part of Ericsson.

auth.evidence_quote: Many newer Vonage APIs require authentication using an API key and secret sent Base64 encoded in the Authorization header.
auth.notes: API key/secret (Basic-style encoding) is the primary credential per search summary; Vonage Video/Voice APIs also use JWT for some endpoints (not independently verified this pass).

access.evidence_quote: When you create a Vonage account, an API key and secret are created for you and located in your account settings in the Vonage Dashboard.
access.notes: Account creation and API key issuance appear self-serve/free (with usage-based billing), consistent with other CPaaS vendors; not independently fetched to confirm trial credit details.

api.evidence_quote: Contribute to the Open Source Vonage MCP Tooling Server
api.notes: Vonage-Community org is a vendor-affiliated open-source org (developer.vonage.com blog links to it), treated as official-adjacent rather than an independent third party; confidence kept low since this wasn't independently confirmed as the same entity as Vonage Inc.

verdict.rationale: Self-serve account creation issues an API key/secret usable immediately across Vonage's communications APIs.
